#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
umask 077
TASK_TRANSFER="${GENOS_DEV_ROOT:-${HOME}/DEV}/TRANSFER"
TASK_LOG_DIR="$TASK_TRANSFER/workflow-live-cards-r3-logs"
if ! mkdir -p "$TASK_LOG_DIR"; then
    TASK_LOG_DIR="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/8-agent-workflow-live-cards-r3-$(id -u)"
    mkdir -p "$TASK_LOG_DIR"
fi
TASK_LOG="$TASK_LOG_DIR/prepare-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)-$$.log"
exec > >(tee -a "$TASK_LOG") 2>&1
trap 'TASK_STATUS=$?; echo "EXIT=$TASK_STATUS LOG=$TASK_LOG"; exit "$TASK_STATUS"' EXIT
echo "Preparing verified editor files only; preserve the existing SSE backend and data"
python3 - "$TASK_TRANSFER/workflow-live-cards-r3-editor" <<'EDITOR_PREPARE_PY'
import base64,hashlib,io,json,os,sys,zipfile
from pathlib import Path
raw=base64.b64decode('')
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()=='a3246134259ad96c0b647433c385a21287e820d7f9edbc43c9c24232ed2aa240'
expected={'GENOS_WORKFLOW_LIVE_CARDS_20261008_R3_PASTE_ALL.txt': 'e120a5a45273df031028519692bb914504fecccf3b377d5f1678ee310e89990e', 'genos_rag_chat.py': '0ccbd94ecb33f05b45dbebfbe3938a03b88f6c4709af008187d2daa0459eff71', 'GUIDE_UTF8.txt': '8378120df2d740cd6f8a23f52bd7762a7df2c05bae17d55b332b2fca05213473', 'VALIDATION_SUMMARY.txt': 'e3dbf6576a44fd76f50e255a06df2ff1fda119d31d1c0a8cac1b396ca7ea72d4', 'VALIDATION.json': '5f0d96695e5a0938394c9d3da051dcdc2e6aa1f076cb68680ab736933a75a66d', 'VERIFY_EDITOR_FILES.txt': '48f29e6064291e19ff24194da31edf81b46ee28fb985d48d81b364574ebc3417', 'MANIFEST.json': 'c619550ecfc3ffbe3e786cb659037cac603c21ee83138b3ff43c39a856e350a6', 'PACKAGE_SHA256SUMS.txt': '6d2b355ea0243bbd6c5aaa08dc4cd61c3af6ac39538778fce8a8544b71f465ac'}
root=Path(sys.argv[1])
if root.is_symlink():raise SystemExit('Existing editor output symlink preserved; choose a separate output')
with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(raw)) as z:
 assert set(z.namelist())==set(expected)
 assert z.testzip() is None
 payload={name:z.read(name) for name in expected}
 for name,blob in payload.items():
  assert hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest()==expected[name]
  target=root/name
  if target.is_symlink():raise SystemExit('Existing symlink preserved: '+str(target))
  if target.exists() and target.read_bytes()!=blob:raise SystemExit('Existing different editor file preserved: '+str(target))
 root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
 for name,blob in payload.items():
  target=root/name
  if not target.exists():
   temp=root/(name+'.writing')
   with temp.open('xb') as f:f.write(blob)
   temp.replace(target)
 for name,pin in expected.items():assert hashlib.sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==pin
print(json.dumps({'status':'EDITOR_FILES_READY','output':str(root.resolve()),
 'paste_file':str((root/'GENOS_WORKFLOW_LIVE_CARDS_20261008_R3_PASTE_ALL.txt').resolve()),
 'zip_sha256':'a3246134259ad96c0b647433c385a21287e820d7f9edbc43c9c24232ed2aa240',
 'workflow_saved':False,'backend_modified':False,'generation_modified':False},ensure_ascii=False))
EDITOR_PREPARE_PY
bash "$TASK_TRANSFER/workflow-live-cards-r3-editor/VERIFY_EDITOR_FILES.txt"
